tara: Quick flag 1: billing console showed a provisional balance went negative after a streaming request retried to another region during a canary. small customer but surfaced in CS. :grimacing:
liam: any traces or logs?
tara: trace session=ses_9bXq excerpt below (sanitized). Looks like stream triggered a toolcall, reconnect happened, router retried to alt region and we lost the idempotency info.
cheng: paste logs?
tara: ``router.INFO: session=ses_9bXq route=us-east->fallback=eu-west reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_204
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (missing)
ledger.INFO: session=ses_9bXq provisional_add=+32 toolcall=ptc_204 truncated=true
ledger.INFO: session=ses_9bXq reconcile_adjust=-48 reason=dedupe-final
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+32 provisional_after=-16``
cheng: yep router rebuilt headers and dropped the prefetch id during fallback. target region created a second toolcall and ledger later deduped, netting negative provisional.
liam: we allow negative adjustments internally but UI must never show negative provisional. short-term: server should clamp usage API provisional to 0 and include an audit tag indicating a reconcile correction so console can explain it.
avery: (cc avery) will add a marquee banner: "Billing correction applied during routed retry" and show 0 instead of negative. will link to audit once ledger exposes id.
cheng: root fix: router must copy prefetch_toolcall_id into X-Toolcall-Idempotency on fallback path. I'll add conservative forwarding only when prefetch=true. will add unit+integration tests to simulate header loss on fallback. ETA next canary.
liam: I'll add a hotfix to clamp and emit metric billing.reconcile.dedupe_count with tags {region,canary}. also log reconcile_reason so CS can filter. ETA ~90m to canary.
tara: SRE repro steps added to PLAT-4209. 1) enable prefetch sidecar, 2) start stream with X-Toolcall-Idempotency header, 3) kill connection mid-toolcall, 4) allow router to fallback to another region, 5) observe provisional.
ops-bot: Alert: provisional_negative_detected account=842 value=-16 canary=canary-2026-07 tags=[prefetch fallback]
deploy-bot: Canary paused canary-2026-07 at 2026-07-12T21:10Z pending fix.
liam: owners: liam (ledger/API clamp + telemetry), cheng (router header propagation), avery (console banner), tara (reporter/SRE).
avery: will wait for ledger audit id to wire banner link. ETA for UI patch 3h after audit available.
cheng: implementing router copy now, will include integration test that asserts no provisional-negative in staging.
liam: adding server-side clamp and audit tag now. will push to canary and follow up with PR link.
tara: thanks all. closing slack thread; followups in PLAT-4209 and PRs. Ping me for raw traces if needed.
